name: copilot-memory-bank
description: One-click persistent project memory for GitHub Copilot: memory-bank templates, slash-command prompts and always-on rules. No manual setup.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Initializing the memory bank writes files into the workspace, which requires trust.

memoryBank.promptOnOpen.description: Offer to initialize the memory bank when a workspace without one is opened.

memoryBank.gitignoreActiveContext.description: When initializing, add memory-bank/activeContext.md to .gitignore (recommended for teams where several developers work in parallel).

memoryBank.installHooks.description: When initializing, also write agent hooks to .github/hooks/ so memory is loaded at session start and the agent is asked to update it before finishing. Requires the chat.useHooks setting in VS Code.

memoryBank.recommendExtension.description: When initializing, add this extension to .vscode/extensions.json so teammates are prompted to install it.

memoryBank.runInitPromptAfterScaffold.description: After creating the template files, open Copilot Chat with /memory-init pre-filled so the agent can fill them from the codebase.
